column1: # stack-db-passwords.tsv — the local stack's per-role passwords, ONE row per key.
# Read by tests/stack/gen-stack-db-env.sh (make stack-up) and scripts/stack-up.ps1
# (the Windows path), and checked by tests/stack/test-gen-stack-db-env.sh against
# every tests/stack/compose*.yaml. Each key is a variable in the gitignored
# tests/stack/.env; the compose files read it as ${KEY:?...} and spell no value.
# Columns (TAB-separated, '#' lines and blank lines ignored):
#   key        the variable compose reads
#   service    the compose service whose container env holds the value an EXISTING
#              volume was created with (read when the key is missing from .env)
#   ctr_env    that container's env variable holding it
#   volumes    the compose volumes (space-separated, WITHOUT the project prefix) that
#              keep the value: when ANY exists the value is adopted, never minted
#   legacy     the literal every compose file spelled before 2026-11-04. It is NOT a
#              default: it is used ONLY to adopt a volume that already exists and
#              has no container left to read, so the operator's existing stack keeps
#              working. A fresh volume always gets a random value.
# key
FEDERATION_DB_PASSWORD
ADMIN_BFF_DB_PASSWORD
FORUM_BFF_DB_PASSWORD
CHARFORGE_BFF_DB_PASSWORD
WIKI_BFF_DB_PASSWORD
OWNCAST_BFF_DB_PASSWORD
TUBE_BFF_DB_PASSWORD
CASDOOR_DB_PASSWORD
CASDOOR_BRANDB_DB_PASSWORD
MASTODON_DB_PASSWORD
PHPBB_DB_PASSWORD
AKKOMA_DB_PASSWORD
GAMES_BFF_DB_PASSWORD
# The homeserver/Mastodon SERVICE-ACCOUNT password admin-bff and user-bff's brokers
# register every provisioned account with. Not a Postgres role, but it persists the
# same way: in the tuwunel volume and in Mastodon's database.
SVC_PASSWORD
